provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

potential: F(P)=a*P^2/2+b*P^4/4-E*P for all real P. The numerical coefficients and P,E,F are in a controlled nondimensional Landau scaling. No sixth-order term, gradient energy or domain structure.
policy: Find every distinct real stationary P and classify local minima by positive F_second. Global equilibrium is the lowest F among all real P, which exists because b>0. Determine the positive field at which the negative-P metastable minimum merges with its adjacent maximum: simultaneous F_first=0 and F_second=0. Report all P arrays in increasing order.
scope: Mean-field homogeneous branch structure; its metastability limit is not an experimental coercive field under finite-time nucleation or domain-wall motion.
